canonical_question: Why did NOI move versus a stated comparison set?

fields.name: entity
fields.description: The asset, property, fund, or portfolio the variance is being explained for

fields.name: period
fields.description: Reporting period for the current value (quarter, month, YTD, T-12)

fields.name: comparison_set
fields.description: What the current value is being compared to (prior quarter, prior year, budget, forecast, underwritten)
fields.data_source: explicit user input or default per concept

fields.name: scope
fields.description: Pool rule (total portfolio, same-property, stabilized, excludes redevelopments, etc.)
fields.data_source: explicit user input or pool membership data

fields.name: basis
fields.description: Cash basis or GAAP/straight-line basis for revenue and concessions
fields.data_source: explicit user input or default basis for the entity

fields.name: sources
fields.description: Source documents and their as-of dates

buckets.name: rate
buckets.definition: Pricing effect on revenue from achieved rents (in-place rent change net of mix)

buckets.name: occupancy
buckets.definition: Physical or economic occupancy change versus the comparison period

buckets.name: mix
buckets.definition: Change in unit mix, tenant mix, or product mix that shifts revenue independent of rate or occupancy

buckets.name: concessions
buckets.definition: Free rent, abatements, and giveaways that reduce effective revenue

buckets.name: vacancy
buckets.definition: Vacancy loss or gain attributable to downtime between leases

buckets.name: bad_debt
buckets.definition: Net bad debt: collection loss or credit loss net of recoveries and reserve movement

buckets.name: recoveries
buckets.definition: CAM, tax, insurance, and utility recoveries from tenants under net leases

buckets.name: taxes
buckets.definition: Real estate taxes (assessment changes, reassessments, abatements)

buckets.name: other
buckets.definition: Items that do not fit the above buckets, including lease termination fees and one-time non-recurring items

reasoning_steps.name: anchor_the_compare
reasoning_steps.description: State the entity, period, comparison set, scope, and basis before computing anything

reasoning_steps.name: compute_total_variance
reasoning_steps.description: Compute the absolute and percentage variance of NOI versus the comparison set

reasoning_steps.name: decompose_revenue
reasoning_steps.description: Decompose revenue change into rate, occupancy, mix, concessions, vacancy, and bad_debt

reasoning_steps.name: decompose_expenses
reasoning_steps.description: Decompose expense change into taxes, insurance, payroll, repairs_maintenance, recoveries, and other

reasoning_steps.name: classify_timing_vs_recurring
reasoning_steps.description: Mark each material driver as timing (one-time) or recurring (run-rate)

reasoning_steps.name: tie_back
reasoning_steps.description: Verify that the sum of driver components closes on the total variance within tolerance

reasoning_steps.name: cite_sources
reasoning_steps.description: Attach the source document and as-of date for every numeric claim

sections.name: direct_answer
sections.description: One sentence stating the variance and the dominant driver

sections.name: metric_block
sections.description: Current, comparison, absolute delta, percent delta, with basis label

sections.name: driver_bridge
sections.description: Closure-shaped list of drivers with sign, magnitude, and bucket name

sections.name: reconciliation
sections.description: Sum of drivers tied back to total variance within tolerance

sections.name: provenance
sections.description: Source documents and their as-of dates

sections.name: caveats
sections.description: Timing-vs-recurring classification, scope/basis caveats, missing data flags

sections.name: confidence
sections.description: Confidence label calibrated against source freshness, completeness, and conflict count

failure_modes.description: The answer mixes cash and GAAP basis without disclosure
A primary source is older than the freshness policy allows
Two preferred sources disagree on a primary value
The pool rule applied does not match what was requested
A value is counted in two driver buckets
A claim has no source in source_inventory
Metric requires waterfall calculation that is not in scope for v1

cannot_compute_rules.precondition: scope is same-property and pool membership data is unavailable
basis is cash and only GAAP data is available
two preferred sources disagree on a primary value
metric requires carry, promote, or gp_share computation

freshness_policy.notes: Rent roll and property P&L within 30 days. Underwriting and approved budget have no age limit (immutable references).

files.name: property_pnl
normalization_rules: period must align to a reporting-period grain (month or quarter)
currency must match the entity reporting currency
opex line items must be classifiable into the driver taxonomy

files.name: rent_roll
normalization_rules: occupancy_status must be one of {occupied, vacant, notice}
currency must match the entity reporting currency

files.name: underwriting
normalization_rules: period must align to a reporting-period grain (month or quarter)
currency must match the entity reporting currency
